# Reference review trigger

## What this idea means

Flag generated reference answers that need more evidence or a human check before guiding a ranking.

## Why it matters

A selective review trigger could reduce avoidable reference failures without reviewing every request.

## How it would work

1. Measure signals that indicate a generated reference may be unreliable.
2. Route flagged references to grounding or human review.
3. Compare the trigger with always-review and never-review controls.

## Current evidence

The existing audits motivate selective escalation, but the local trigger and its
acceptance rule are not yet frozen. Completed E5 refinement evidence is recorded
as a study, not mislabeled as a future ready test.

## What is missing

- Decision rule
- Dependencies
- Artifact plan

## What happens next

Define the local trigger features and acceptance rule.
